title: prohibitive — crumble

sentences.sentence: prohibitive regulations
sentences.translation: 禁律

sentences.sentence: Although he failed as a prospector, he succeeded as a journalist.
sentences.translation: 他作为采矿者遭遇失败，但作为记者大获成功。

sentences.sentence: The man, of Asian descent, wearing the clothes of a low-level prospector, seemed to be quite intrigued by what was going on inside.
sentences.translation: 一个亚洲血统的男人，穿着初级勘探者的制服站在窗外，似乎对这里面的情况很感兴趣。

sentences.sentence: apparent contradictions in the defendant’s testimony
sentences.translation: 被告证词中的明显矛盾

sentences.sentence: Anderson was to sing at the Constitution Hall auditorium.
sentences.translation: 安德森将要在宪法厅的观众席演唱。

sentences.sentence: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
sentences.translation: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

sentences.sentence: In old-fashioned schools, much learning was by rote .
sentences.translation: 在旧式学校里，很多学习都是靠死记硬背。

sentences.sentence: the rote learning of facts
sentences.translation: 对资料的死记硬背

sentences.sentence: A new battleship was launched from a shipyard.
sentences.translation: 一艘新战舰从船坞下水。

sentences.sentence: The new battleship shall be armed with 16-inch guns.
sentences.translation: 新战舰将以16英寸口径的大炮武装起来。

sentences.sentence: The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
sentences.translation: 该政权清除了大多数反对者。

sentences.sentence: I know there are those who don’t believe we can do all these things. I understand the skepticism.
sentences.translation: 我知道有些人不相信我们可以完成所有这些事情，我理解他们所持的怀疑态度。

sentences.sentence: Therefore, I do not think we should go in for complete skepticism, but for a doctrine of degrees of probability.
sentences.translation: 因而我绝不认为我们应当赞成彻底的怀疑主义，而是赞成可能性程度的学说。

sentences.sentence: I understand that skepticism, which is why this recovery plan must and will include unprecedented measures that will allow the American people to hold my Administration accountable for these results.
sentences.translation: 我理解这些怀疑，这也是为什么复苏计划一定要包括这些前所未有的措施，即将会允许美国人民要我的政府对这些计划的结果负责。

sentences.sentence: Do you have some hints for me, how to become a good economist?
sentences.translation: 如何成为一名好的经济学家，你有什么给我的提示吗？

sentences.sentence: You know, Gordon, I should not like you. You are Scottish, we have nothing in common and you are an economist.
sentences.translation: 你知道吗，戈登，我不应该喜欢你，你是苏格兰人，又是个经济学家，我们没有任何共同的地方。

sentences.sentence: So you would not break the third commandment.
sentences.translation: 那么你就不会违反第三条戒律。

sentences.sentence: A friend of mine applied this commandment in his own life, with great success.
sentences.translation: 我的一位朋友在自己的生活中应用了这个戒律，而且大获成功。

sentences.sentence: Some of the fans had waited 24 hours outside the hotel to catch a glimpse of their heroine.
sentences.translation: 某些追星族为了一睹女杰的风采已在宾馆外守候了24小时。

sentences.sentence: For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
sentences.translation: 做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。

sentences.sentence: In warm weather, clothes made of natural fabrics are infinitely preferable (= much better ) .
sentences.translation: 天气暖和的时候，穿天然织物的衣服要舒适得多。

sentences.sentence: The document delineates your rights and your obligations.
sentences.translation: 这份文件阐明了你的权利和义务。

translations.translation: 高低不平的, 崎岖的

sentences.sentence: a rugged coastline
sentences.translation: 崎岖不平的海岸线

sentences.sentence: the rugged beauty of the Highlands
sentences.translation: 苏格兰高地崎岖起伏的美景

translations.translation: 吉普赛人(的),吉普赛语（的）

sentences.sentence: I'm proud of being brought up by gypsies.
sentences.translation: 我为自己是吉卜赛人抚养长大的而感到自豪。

sentences.sentence: This landslide deposit pretty much rules out the idea that the deposits farther upstream are glacial outwash.
sentences.translation: 这个滑坡沉积物大可以排除远离上游的沉积物是冰川沉积的想法。

sentences.sentence: Sometimes the animal multitudes are horizontal, as on Salisbury Plain, a glacial outwash delta densely colonized by king penguins, fur and elephant seals, and kelp gulls.
sentences.translation: 有些地方动物种群是水平分布的，比如在索尔兹伯里平原，这块冰碛沉积三角洲密集分布着王企鹅、软毛海豹、象海豹和黑背海鸥。

sentences.sentence: Hmm. At the time our colleague suggested that maybe these were delta deposits or possibly glacial outwash (although we don’t know the extent of past glaciations in the park).
sentences.translation: 嗯，当时我们同事建议这些可能是三角洲沉淀或者可能是冰川沉积时（尽管我们不知道这个公园里冰期的程度）。

sentences.sentence: The old stonework was crumbling away.
sentences.translation: 古老的石筑部分逐渐崩塌。

sentences.sentence: crumbling colonial buildings
sentences.translation: 逐渐坍塌的殖民时期建筑

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 248 单元

prohibitive
音标：英 /prə(ʊ)'hɪbɪtɪv/  美 /prə'hɪbətɪv/
adj. 禁止的, 抑制的
例句：prohibitive regulations
禁律

prospector
音标：英 /prəʊ'spektə/  美 /'prɑspɛktɚ/
n. 探勘者, 采矿者
例句：Although he failed as a prospector, he succeeded as a journalist.
他作为采矿者遭遇失败，但作为记者大获成功。
例句：The man, of Asian descent, wearing the clothes of a low-level prospector, seemed to be quite intrigued by what was going on inside.
一个亚洲血统的男人，穿着初级勘探者的制服站在窗外，似乎对这里面的情况很感兴趣。

contradiction
音标：英 /kɒntrə'dɪkʃ(ə)n/  美 /,kɑntrə'dɪkʃən/
n. 反驳, 矛盾
短语：contradiction between — 矛盾，不一致
短语：in contradiction to — 同…相矛盾
短语：in contradiction with — 与…相抵触；与…矛盾着
例句：apparent contradictions in the defendant’s testimony
被告证词中的明显矛盾

auditorium
音标：英 /ɔːdɪ'tɔːrɪəm/  美 /,ɔdɪ'tɔrɪəm/
n. 听众席,观众席,
例句：Anderson was to sing at the Constitution Hall auditorium.
安德森将要在宪法厅的观众席演唱。

remark
音标：英 /rɪ'mɑːk/  美 /rɪ'mɑrk/
n. 备注,评论 vt评论
短语：remark on — 评论；谈论；议论
例句：Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

rote
音标：英 /rəʊt/  美 /rot/
n. 死记硬背
短语：by rote — 死记硬背
短语：rote learning — 机械学习
短语：rote memorization — 死记硬背；机械背诵
例句：In old-fashioned schools, much learning was by rote .
在旧式学校里，很多学习都是靠死记硬背。
例句：the rote learning of facts
对资料的死记硬背

battleship
音标：英 /'bæt(ə)lʃɪp/  美 /'bætlʃɪp/
n. 战舰
例句：A new battleship was launched from a shipyard.
一艘新战舰从船坞下水。
例句：The new battleship shall be armed with 16-inch guns.
新战舰将以16英寸口径的大炮武装起来。

regime
音标：英 /reɪ'ʒiːm/  美 /re'ʒim/
n. 政权制度,政权
短语：flow regime — 流态；水流动态
短语：water regime — 水情；水文状况
短语：military regime — 军事政权
短语：hydrological regime — 水文状况，水分状况
短语：thermal regime — 热状况；热动态；热体制
短语：exchange-rate regime — 汇率机制
短语：currency regime — 汇率制度
例句：The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
该政权清除了大多数反对者。

skepticism
音标：英 /'skeptisizəm/  美 /'skɛptɪ,sɪzəm/
n. 怀疑论
例句：I know there are those who don’t believe we can do all these things. I understand the skepticism.
我知道有些人不相信我们可以完成所有这些事情，我理解他们所持的怀疑态度。
例句：Therefore, I do not think we should go in for complete skepticism, but for a doctrine of degrees of probability.
因而我绝不认为我们应当赞成彻底的怀疑主义，而是赞成可能性程度的学说。
例句：I understand that skepticism, which is why this recovery plan must and will include unprecedented measures that will allow the American people to hold my Administration accountable for these results.
我理解这些怀疑，这也是为什么复苏计划一定要包括这些前所未有的措施，即将会允许美国人民要我的政府对这些计划的结果负责。

economist
音标：英 /ɪ'kɒnəmɪst/  美 /ɪ'kɑnəmɪst/
n. 经济学者
短语：senior economist — 高级经济师
短语：economist intelligence unit — 经济学人智库
例句：Do you have some hints for me, how to become a good economist?
如何成为一名好的经济学家，你有什么给我的提示吗？
例句：You know, Gordon, I should not like you. You are Scottish, we have nothing in common and you are an economist.
你知道吗，戈登，我不应该喜欢你，你是苏格兰人，又是个经济学家，我们没有任何共同的地方。

commandment
音标：英 /kə'mɑːndmənt/  美 /kə'mændmənt/
n. 戒律
例句：So you would not break the third commandment.
那么你就不会违反第三条戒律。
例句：A friend of mine applied this commandment in his own life, with great success.
我的一位朋友在自己的生活中应用了这个戒律，而且大获成功。

glimpse
音标：英 /glɪm(p)s/  美 /ɡlɪmps/
n. 一瞥v瞥见
短语：glimpse of — 瞥见；一瞥
短语：catch a glimpse of — 瞥见
短语：glimpse at — v. 看到；瞥见
短语：get a glimpse of — 瞥见
例句：Some of the fans had waited 24 hours outside the hotel to catch a glimpse of their heroine.
某些追星族为了一睹女杰的风采已在宾馆外守候了24小时。

preferable
音标：英 /'pref(ə)rəb(ə)l/  美 /'prɛfrəbl/
adj. 更好的,更合意的
例句：For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。
例句：In warm weather, clothes made of natural fabrics are infinitely preferable (= much better ) .
天气暖和的时候，穿天然织物的衣服要舒适得多。

delineate
音标：英 /dɪ'lɪnɪeɪt/  美 /dɪ'lɪnɪet/
v. 描绘
例句：The document delineates your rights and your obligations.
这份文件阐明了你的权利和义务。

rugged
音标：英 /'rʌgɪd/  美 /'rʌɡɪd/
adj. 高低不平的, 崎岖的
短语：rugged terrain — 不平地形，崎岖地带
短语：rugged individualism — 顽强的个人主义
例句：a rugged coastline
崎岖不平的海岸线
例句：the rugged beauty of the Highlands
苏格兰高地崎岖起伏的美景

referent
音标：英 /'ref(ə)r(ə)nt/  美 /'rɛfərənt/
n. 指示物

inadequacy
音标：英 /ɪn'ædɪkwəsɪ/  美 /ɪn'ædɪkwəsi/
n. 不充分

Gypsy
n&a. 吉普赛人(的),吉普赛语（的）
短语：gypsy moth — 舞毒蛾（等于Porthetria dispar）
例句：I'm proud of being brought up by gypsies.
我为自己是吉卜赛人抚养长大的而感到自豪。

outwash
音标：英 /'aʊtwɒʃ/  美 /'aʊtwɑʃ/
n. [地质]冰水沉积
例句：This landslide deposit pretty much rules out the idea that the deposits farther upstream are glacial outwash.
这个滑坡沉积物大可以排除远离上游的沉积物是冰川沉积的想法。
例句：Sometimes the animal multitudes are horizontal, as on Salisbury Plain, a glacial outwash delta densely colonized by king penguins, fur and elephant seals, and kelp gulls.
有些地方动物种群是水平分布的，比如在索尔兹伯里平原，这块冰碛沉积三角洲密集分布着王企鹅、软毛海豹、象海豹和黑背海鸥。
例句：Hmm. At the time our colleague suggested that maybe these were delta deposits or possibly glacial outwash (although we don’t know the extent of past glaciations in the park).
嗯，当时我们同事建议这些可能是三角洲沉淀或者可能是冰川沉积时（尽管我们不知道这个公园里冰期的程度）。

crumble
音标：英 /'krʌmb(ə)l/  美 /'krʌmbl/
v. 弄碎,崩溃
例句：The old stonework was crumbling away.
古老的石筑部分逐渐崩塌。
例句：crumbling colonial buildings
逐渐坍塌的殖民时期建筑
